title: Why The Great Barrier Reef Can't Catch A Break
hook: The reef keeps bleaching again before it even finishes healing from the last time.
closing: Repeated bleaching can erase a decade of reef recovery before it finishes.
question: Can the reef recover in time?

segments.say: The reef has now bleached 3 times this decade, turning a once-rare crisis into a regular one.
The gap between bleaching events has shrunk to just 2 years on average.
A reef typically needs 10 years to recover, so the next bleaching wave keeps arriving first.
